COMMENT.description:
COMMENT lines of the message (CCSDS 504.0-B-2) from its header, metadata and
data groups, in message order, joined by a line feed. A state group's own
comments stay with it.

CLASSIFICATION.description:
CLASSIFICATION of the message: the optional header keyword stating its
security classification or handling caveat.

MESSAGE_ID.description:
MESSAGE_ID: the optional header keyword, an identifier the originator makes
unique for this message.

CENTER_NAME.description: CENTER_NAME: the orbit center, when the message states one.

TIME_SYSTEM.description: TIME_SYSTEM: the time system EPOCH and the maneuver epochs are in.

QUATERNION_STATES.description:
Quaternion states (QUAT_START block), in message order. Q1..QC above are the
single frameless quaternion of the earlier form of this record; a message is
read into and written from these lists.

EULER_ANGLE_STATES.description: Euler angle states (EULER_START block), in message order.

ANGULAR_VELOCITIES.description: Angular velocities (ANGVEL_START block), in message order.

SPIN_STATES.description: Spin states (SPIN_START block), in message order.

INERTIAS.description: Inertia tensors (INERTIA_START block), in message order.

MANEUVERS.description: Attitude maneuvers (MAN_START block), in message order.

APMQuaternionState.description:
A quaternion state of an APM (CCSDS 504.0-B-2 Table 3-3): rotation from
REF_FRAME_A to REF_FRAME_B. The derivative is NaN when the message states none.

COMMENT.description: COMMENT lines of this block, joined by a line feed.

REF_FRAME_A.description: REF_FRAME_A: the frame the rotation starts from.

REF_FRAME_B.description: REF_FRAME_B: the frame the rotation ends in.

Q1_DOT.description: Q1_DOT in 1/s, NaN when not stated.

Q2_DOT.description: Q2_DOT in 1/s, NaN when not stated.

Q3_DOT.description: Q3_DOT in 1/s, NaN when not stated.

QC_DOT.description: QC_DOT in 1/s, NaN when not stated.

APMEulerAngleState.description:
An Euler angle state of an APM (EULER_START block). Angles in degrees; a rate
is NaN when the message states none.

COMMENT.description: COMMENT lines of this block, joined by a line feed.

REF_FRAME_A.description: REF_FRAME_A: the frame the rotation starts from.

REF_FRAME_B.description: REF_FRAME_B: the frame the rotation ends in.

EULER_ROT_SEQ.description: EULER_ROT_SEQ: the rotation sequence, for example ZXZ.

ANGLE_1_DOT.description: ANGLE_1_DOT in deg/s, NaN when not stated.

ANGLE_2_DOT.description: ANGLE_2_DOT in deg/s, NaN when not stated.

ANGLE_3_DOT.description: ANGLE_3_DOT in deg/s, NaN when not stated.

APMAngularVelocity.description: An angular velocity of an APM (ANGVEL_START block), in deg/s.

COMMENT.description: COMMENT lines of this block, joined by a line feed.

REF_FRAME_A.description: REF_FRAME_A: the frame the rotation starts from.

REF_FRAME_B.description: REF_FRAME_B: the frame the rotation ends in.

ANGVEL_FRAME.description: ANGVEL_FRAME: the frame the components are in.

APMSpinState.description:
A spin state of an APM (SPIN_START block). The nutation terms come as either of
two groups, nutation angle, period and phase or the momentum direction and the
velocity around it; those not stated are NaN.

COMMENT.description: COMMENT lines of this block, joined by a line feed.

REF_FRAME_A.description: REF_FRAME_A: the frame the rotation starts from.

REF_FRAME_B.description: REF_FRAME_B: the frame the rotation ends in.

SPIN_ALPHA.description: SPIN_ALPHA: right ascension of the spin axis in degrees.

SPIN_DELTA.description: SPIN_DELTA: declination of the spin axis in degrees.

NUTATION.description: NUTATION: nutation angle in degrees, NaN when not stated.

NUTATION_PER.description: NUTATION_PER: nutation period in seconds, NaN when not stated.

NUTATION_PHASE.description: NUTATION_PHASE: nutation phase in degrees, NaN when not stated.

MOMENTUM_ALPHA.description:
MOMENTUM_ALPHA: right ascension of the angular momentum vector in degrees,
NaN when not stated.

MOMENTUM_DELTA.description:
MOMENTUM_DELTA: declination of the angular momentum vector in degrees, NaN
when not stated.

NUTATION_VEL.description:
NUTATION_VEL: angular velocity around the momentum vector in deg/s, NaN when
not stated.

APMInertia.description: An inertia tensor of an APM (INERTIA_START block), in kg*m**2.

COMMENT.description: COMMENT lines of this block, joined by a line feed.

INERTIA_REF_FRAME.description: INERTIA_REF_FRAME: the frame the tensor is in.

APMManeuver.description: An attitude maneuver of an APM (MAN_START block).

COMMENT.description: COMMENT lines of this block, joined by a line feed.

MAN_EPOCH_START.description: MAN_EPOCH_START: epoch of the start of the maneuver.

MAN_REF_FRAME.description: MAN_REF_FRAME: the frame the torque is in.

MAN_DELTA_MASS.description: MAN_DELTA_MASS in kg (negative or zero), NaN when not stated.
